get.summary: Retrieves measured and calculated data for measuring points.

parameters.name: timeRangeStart
parameters.description:
The earliest timestamp to include in the results, formatted as an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g.,
'2025-01-15T00:00:00Z').

parameters.name: timeRangeEnd
parameters.description:
The latest timestamp to include in the results, formatted as an ISO 8601 date-time string (e.g.,
'2025-01-16T00:00:00Z').

parameters.name: aggregationInterval
parameters.description: The interval in which the data should be aggregated.

parameters.name: edgeGatewayIds
parameters.description: A list of GUIDs, each uniquely identifying an edge gateway.

parameters.name: serviceIds
parameters.description: A list of GUIDs, each uniquely identifying a service.

parameters.name: measuringPointIdentifiers
parameters.description: A list of human-readable identifiers unique within the service

parameters.name: measuringPointUniqueIdentifiers
parameters.description: A list of unique measuring point identifiers

parameters.name: fillingMode
parameters.description: Specifies whether missing data points should be filled and my which method.

parameters.name: timeZoneName
parameters.description:
Specifies the IANA timezone name to be used for aggregation windows. If not provided, the default timezone is
Europe/Zurich.
timescale: input to time_bucket and time_bucket_gapfill function

Cloud.Api.TenantApis.MeasuringPoints.Dto.title: MeasurementQuality
Cloud.Api.TenantApis.MeasuringPoints.Dto.description: The quality of the measuring point, representing the data source or processing applied.

serviceId.title: Guid
serviceId.description: The unique identifier (GUID) of the service associated with the measuring point.

identifier.title: String
identifier.description: A unique, human-readable identifier for the measuring point, specific to the service.

values.title: List`1
values.description: A list of measurement values for the measuring point.

value.title: Nullable`1
value.description: The measured value captured for the measuring point.

dateTime.title: DateTime
dateTime.description:
The timestamp when the measurement was recorded, formatted as an ISO 8601 date string (e.g.,
'2025-01-15T14:30:00Z').

subscriberId.title: String
subscriberId.description:
Must be unique for each (ui, cloud, etc.) client and is used to identify the client.
The mqtt client must use thi id in his last will /sw/cloud/client/lastWill/{clientId}
